post.title: AppLovin Soared 31% as the Nasdaq Plunged 6% 📈
post.description:
AppLovin (APP) jumped 31.1% on Thursday, Nov 5, the day after beating earnings ($4.30 a share vs $4.01 expected), while the Nasdaq 100 (QQQ) fell 6.4%. It's now up 56% in four trading days.

Thursday's big movers:
📈 AppLovin (APP) +31.1%
📈 Unity (U) +15.0%
📉 Sandisk (SNDK) −22.3%
📉 AMD −17.7%
📉 Micron (MU) −17.2%
📉 Nvidia (NVDA) −9.3%

After the bell (as of 5:19 pm ET):
📈 Cloudflare (NET) +14.8%, EPS $0.38 vs $0.28 expected
📈 Airbnb (ABNB) +10.6%, EPS $3.16 vs $2.85 expected
📉 DraftKings (DKNG) −21.7%, EPS −$0.53 vs −$0.26 expected

S&P 500 (SPY): −4.4% · Nasdaq 100 (QQQ): −6.4% · Dow (DIA): −3.5%

Which move would you have traded? Tell me in the comments.
